jobs.description:
Do you speak English very well and are you looking for a flexible administrative job where the work-life balance is highly important? Then you are perfectly suited for the international and renowned company we are looking for.

You will be responsible for opening and processing insurance claim files. You will also be in charge of handling damage payments and other insurance-related inquiries. Additionally, you will stay in contact with clients (via phone or email) for any missing or additional information.

You will be part of an international and friendly team where you can always rely on your colleagues and team leader, while also having the necessary independence.
-Excellent English language skills.
-Dutch is not required, but a plus. 
-Ability to work in a structured manner.
-A first experience in administration or equivalent by diploma.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

The organisation is one of the leading companies in its field. Their offices are located in Diegem close to the train station. You'll join a dynamic and multicultural team in an entry-level position and a company that invests in the growth potential and the well-being of their employees.

Jobomschrijving

As an administrative assistant you'll be responsible for:

• Providing administrative support to paralegals and attorneys
• Managing calls, emails and mail with stakeholders
• Collecting and assessing accuracy of official documents and certificates
• Maintaining efficient filing system for all relevant documents
• Coordinating administration of ongoing projects

• Bachelor in administration, office management, languages or any related field
• Excellent level of French and English, Dutch is a plus
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Detail oriented and excellent teamspirit

• Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, power distribution equipment, switchgear, MCCBs, RMUs, DSO or related electrical solutions.
• Commercially driven with the ability to build relationships and develop new business opportunities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to further develop your accounting expertise in a dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative environment.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international organization based in Zaventem, supporting operations across Europe in sectors such as automotive, industrial, energy, and materials.

As a Finance & Accounting Specialist, you will support day-to-day accounting activities, month-end closings, reporting processes, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives while working closely with colleagues across the business.

Your Responsibilities

Sales & Purchase Accounting
	
• Support the Sales Department with accounting treatment, SAP bookings, and invoice reviews.	
• Review outgoing invoices and maintain accounting procedures and manuals.	
• Expenses & Invoice Management	
• Process expense invoices and bank transactions in SAP.	
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-related queries.	
• Review and process employee expense claims via SAP Concur.	
• Keep procedures up to date and contribute to process improvements and Kaizen initiatives.
General Accounting Support
	
• Assist with monthly closings and reporting.	
• Perform reconciliations, bank postings, account reviews, and follow-up on open items.	
• Support invoice booking and resolve accounting discrepancies.	
• Prepare documentation for audits 	
• Provide backup support for payments, banking, foreign exchange, and other finance-related activities.	
• Support the Accounting Manager with accruals, 

Your Profile
	
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.	
• Approximately 2 to 3 years of relevant accounting experience.	
• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.	
• Experience working with SAP is a strong asset.	
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, especially Excel.	
• Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.	
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement attitude.	
• Able to work independently while being a strong team player.	
• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management abilities.	
• Fluent in English, with a good knowledge of Dutch and French.

Our client is a global leader in integrated real estate and facility management services, supporting large corporate and industrial environments. The organisation delivers end-to-end technical, operational, and workplace solutions, with a strong focus on safety, innovation, digital tools, and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Ensure high-quality, cost-efficient, and safe delivery of engineering and technical services across the site.
• Manage engineering service providers and suppliers in collaboration with procurement teams.
• Oversee infrastructure maintenance, utilities, and engineering operations, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery (24/7).
• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Engineering SOPs, ensuring regular training and operational compliance.
• Support preventive maintenance programs using CMMS tools, ensuring data accuracy and asset reliability.
• Prepare and maintain long-term capital and infrastructure investment plans, aligned with site leadership priorities.

By combining technical expertise, customer focus, and operational excellence, they help our clients improve their performance and achieve their business objectives.

Their success is built on long-term partnerships, a collaborative culture, and a passion for delivering value. They continuously invest in innovation, sustainability, and the development of their people to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving market.

• Maintain accurate records and sales forecasts using the CRM system.

• Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset with a solution-driven approach.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Organized, autonomous, and results-driven.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, or similar) is an asset.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer (French-Dutch-English, Night Shifts), you are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You’ll work within a small, supportive team to ensure that stranded vehicles or trucks get back on the road quickly. You’ll communicate by phone and email with customers, partners, and technical service providers. Your dedication and attention to detail help resolve a wide range of customer questions and issues, contributing to seamless service delivery.

On a typical day, you’ll handle incoming calls and emails, gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, and provide technical support where possible. You’ll keep customers and stakeholders updated, monitor agreements, and ensure all contract-related matters are handled within agreed deadlines. You’ll work night shifts from Thursday to Saturday (8:00 am to 8:00 pm), which allows for variety in your schedule and challenges your multitasking skills.

Are you a strong communicator, resilient under pressure, and customer-focused? Do you want to join a multicultural team where learning and growth are central? Apply today and discover how you can make a real impact for people in need.

• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English; any additional language is a plus

• Degree in higher secondary education, associate degree, or (professional/academic) bachelor

• Strong communication skills over phone and email

• Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Accurate, resilient under stress, and able to multitask

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• Customer- and results-oriented

• No specific experience necessary; motivation and eagerness to learn are essential

jobs.description:

• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
